identity.name: Bob French
identity.summary: New Orleans traditional jazz drummer and WWOZ radio host who led the Tuxedo Jazz Band from 1977 until his death.

contribution.description: Led the Tuxedo Jazz Band, the band once led by Papa Celestin and then his father, from 1977 to 2012, carrying the traditional New Orleans drumming he learned from Louis Barbarin; he also recorded R&B in the 1960s with Earl King, Snooks Eaglin and Fats Domino.
